Stellantis faces strike threat over Canadian plant sale

Stellantis is facing a potential strike in Canada after the automotive company announced plans to sell its Brampton assembly plant. The Unifor union, representing workers at the plant, has stated that strike action is on the table if Stellantis proceeds with the sale. The union is pushing for the company to reconsider its decision and explore alternatives to the sale. The future of the plant and its workforce remains uncertain as negotiations are expected to continue.
